intro.text: Girard Wealth Management Group is Frank Girard's financial planning practice on Mark Tree Road in East Setauket, a private wealth advisory practice of Raymond James. Frank holds the CFP®, ChFC, CLU and CFS designations, grew up in Dix Hills and lives in East Setauket. He works with a team: James L. McLoughlin, AIF, Branch Manager Arthur Gonsalves, Office Manager Lauren Lobo and Client Service Associates Eva Girard and Linxiu Song.
